record.question: Principle of compass surveying -
record.explanation: Compass surveying measures directions/bearings and lengths of a sequence of connected lines, forming a traverse. Its governing method is traversing. Reference: https://bharatskills.gov.in/pdf/E_Books/Surveyor1stsemTT.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
